gaps.note: no FS document held states a cable capacity for CMV-DFDS45U5W: the steel datasheet has no capacity table, and the portfolio and the guide give none.
gaps.wanted: a capacity row on the product page or in a later datasheet

gaps.note: the quick-release bracket plates bolt to the spine between the two channels and hook onto L-brackets on the upright; how far the duct then stands from the upright is drawn in the guide but never dimensioned. The duct is drawn without the brackets, which ship loose.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the brackets fitted to an AR201 upright

gaps.note: the drawing leaves one rack unit without a finger at one end and puts the 976.95 cover there; it is taken as the top because that is how the datasheet page stands, and no view says which end is up.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of an installed duct with its top end in view
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - style, sides, backbone and cover material (Steel/SPCC), colour, the detachable covers, the 45U open rack it matches and RoHS and ISO 9001 are the specification table and Standards Compliance list of the datasheet. The fixings are the guide step 2 for the dual, twice the single list of the product page. The ABS of the features list is copied from the plastic datasheet; the fingers are given as plastic and the body as steel.

bottom.note: drawing - the bottom end is the top end again.

capacity.note: not stated - no capacity is carried: neither the steel datasheet nor the guide nor the portfolio gives a cable capacity for CMV-DFDS45U5W, so the figure is the `cable-capacity` gap below, not a datasheet fact.

chassis.note: drawing - THE DUCT AS IT STANDS, covers fitted: `width` across the face of the rack, `height` the height it runs, `depth` front to back. 169 wide is the cover, dimensioned 169 on the cover view of both drawings; the back view measures the same 72 px at the 0.4247 px/mm of the 2000.25, and the end view draws the cover line across the same 72 px, over finger rows 160 apart outside. The specification table, the portfolio and the page title give 141.52 (5.5 in) wide: the end view of the dual dimensions 141.52 between the inner faces of the two rows, so that figure is the channel, not the part, and the single end view dimensions 145.76 across the same rows. The two renders read 159 and 164 for the cover once the turn of the camera is solved, at about five per cent; the dimensioned 169 is taken. 2000.25 high is the drawing (45 x 44.45); the table rounds it to 2000.

color.note: estimated - Color: Black. Every image FS publishes of the part is a render; it is drawn in the shades the FS horizontal steel ducts read off theirs.

cover.note: drawing - covers on both faces. The datasheet table (Finger Duct with Cover, Detachable Cover: Yes), the cover view, the renders (gallery images 2, 4 and 5) and the quick start guide step 4 show them. The product page heads its description Single Sided, an FS copy error: its title, the datasheet, the portfolio and the drawing say Dual Sided.

depth.note: drawing - 307.66 is the end view and the specification table, from one cover to the other. It is 2.4 more than two singles of 152.63, so the spine is drawn 2.4 and each channel well 152.63 deep from its cover to the face of the spine; the single back plate is 1.2 deep, so the dual covers stand 1.2 further from the fingers, estimated.

front.note: drawing - each working face is the single face: the rows 9.0 thick with their inner faces 141.52 apart (dimensioned on this end view), 44 fingers a row at 44.45 with the top rack unit empty, and the two covers over them. The finger is the single one, the same moulding (fs/cmv-fds45u5w-finger).

guides.note: drawing - one duct on each of the front and rear views, the channel between the finger rows, 141.52 wide, run down the height; pitch 44.45, gap 34.25 between stems.

left.note: drawing - the side view, rear at x=0: both channels, each with its return, 44 blocks, stems and heads, six clips and two covers, the spine at the middle. The bracket plates the side view draws on the spine are not drawn (see the bracket gap).

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE VENDOR DRAWING. The FS Vertical Cable Managers with Finger Ducts datasheet for the steel managers (portal id 6868) draws CMV-DFDS45U5W on page 4 four ways in millimetres - a side view, a cover view, section A-A through the spine and an end view - laid on its side in one embedded raster (1341 x 689). Measured at native size: 842 px along the dimensioned 2000.25 (0.4209 px/mm) and 128.5 px across the dimensioned 307.66 on the end view (0.4177), about 2.4 mm a pixel. The dual is the single section of page 3 on both faces of one spine, and the single drawing, at the finer scale, gives the figures the two share. The steel quick start guide (steps 1 and 4) and the renders of #220091 (gallery images 2 to 5) are the second reading.

mount.note: drawing - `rack-side`. The steel quick start guide step 3 bolts quick-release brackets to the side of the upright with screws and cage nuts and the duct stands beside the rack, outside the rails; step 1 draws the dual with its brackets on the spine between the two channels. The datasheet says it matches a 45U open rack. It occupies no rack unit; `ru: 45` is the height it runs beside.

rear.note: drawing - the rear channel is the front channel turned round, as the end view and the side view draw it, symmetric about the spine.

right.note: drawing - the left view mirrored: the duct is the same on both sides.

sections.note: drawing - two sections a face. The cover view dimensions an upper cover 976.95 and a lower one 1021.4 (the single page draws 976.45); together they leave 1.9 of the 2000.25, put at the joint. Section A-A draws the joint of the spine at the same 977.2 as the single.

shell.note: drawing - A HOLLOW DUCT ON EACH SIDE, NOT A BOX. A sheet body whose views are elevations. The front and rear views each carry the spine as a well 152.63 deep, its floor the face of the spine and open at its seven windows through to the other channel, with two steel returns, 88 fingers and two covers that come off. The windows join the two channels and reach neither outer face, so no face declares a `passes:` entry; they are the holes in each floor.

spine.note: drawing - section A-A draws the spine as the single back view: the same seven openings, six pairs of keyholes 311 apart (the outer pair 1555, dimensioned) and the square holes. The keyholes and squares are not drawn on the dual: no face shows the spine except through the open windows of its floors.

thickness.note: estimated - no FS document states the gauge of the SPCC; 1.2 is taken, as for the FS horizontal steel managers in the library, and the spine is the 2.4 the depths leave.

top.note: drawing - the end view, rear cover at y=0: the rear channel, the 2.4 spine at the middle of the 307.66, the front channel, each half from the spine outward the single stack (return 37.7, block to 62.4, stem to 141.3, head to 148.43, cover 150.83 to 152.03).

weight.note: datasheet - 19.2 kg, the FS product page specification for #220091 as read at intake, twice the single; the datasheet states no weight.
